notes.title: 🐎 Storm Horse Simulator — Dev Log 001: Our Wild Journey Begins!
notes.content:
🐎 Storm Horse Simulator — Dev Log 001: Our Wild Journey Begins!
Hello everyone, and welcome to our very first dev log for Spirit Horse Simulator! 🌄✨

We’re thrilled to finally share a behind-the-scenes look at what we’ve been working on — and to bring you along for this wild ride from the very beginning.
[hr][/hr]🌿 What is Storm Horse Simulator?
In Storm Horse Simulator, you step into the hooves of a free-spirited horse exploring a vast, living world. Gallop across breathtaking open landscapes, survive the challenges of nature, bond with your herd, and discover your own unique path through the wilderness.

It’s more than just a simulation — it’s about living the untamed life of a wild horse and experiencing the true spirit of freedom and adventure.
[hr][/hr]🐴 How Far Along Are We?
We’re excited to share that about 60% of the game is already complete! 🙌

Our team has been hard at work developing:
✅ Open World Environments — Lush forests, open plains, rivers, and hidden trails that feel alive and immersive.
✅ Realistic Horse Movement & Animation — From galloping and grazing to authentic herd behaviors, your horse feels expressive and real.
✅ Herd & Wildlife AI — The world is filled with dynamic herds and other animals, adding surprise and life to every area.
✅ Weather & Day/Night Cycle — Changing weather and time of day bring a sense of realism and new challenges.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681610/bc623952b76048cb50863dd7cd1bec55f5de1610.gif"]
[hr][/hr]🔭 What’s Next?
We’re now focusing on the next big steps:
🌟 Expanding the world — We’re working on new locations and biomes for you to explore.
🌟 Designing new quests — To give players meaningful goals, surprises, and choices along their journey.
🌟 Polishing survival elements and customization — Making sure the gameplay stays fresh and rewarding.
🌟 Preparing an early build — We can’t wait to share it with you and hear your thoughts!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681610/1e04a86f73cc565e204ec3eb76e0ce05fb3d09cb.gif"]
[hr][/hr]🤝 Join Us on This Adventure!
This is just the beginning — and we’d love to take this journey together. We’ll be sharing regular dev logs, concept art, and behind-the-scenes peeks as we continue to grow Spirit Horse Simulator into something truly special for horse lovers and adventure fans alike.

💬 Don’t forget to join our Discord channel for the latest news, sneak peeks, and community chats: 

https://discord.gg/mYvv2PmNnw



Your feedback and support mean so much to us. And don’t forget to wishlist Spirit Horse Simulator on Steam to stay updated!

Run free, stay wild — and we’ll see you in the next dev log! 🐎💨✨

— The Spirit Horse Simulator Team
